question: Name the Kalvari class submarine launched in Mumbai in Nov 2020.
solution:
​The correct answer is __**INS Vagir**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Kalvari class submarine** launched in Mumbai in Nov 2020 is **INS Vagir.**
 
• **Indian Navy’s **fifth Kalvari-class Diesel Electric attack submarine **INS Vagir** was launched at** Mazgaon Dock in Mumbai**, The ship was launched on **12 November 2020**.
 
• The submarine inherits its name from **INS Vagir** which served in the Navy from 19
